description: Set the multiplicative factor for stiffnesses to be added to structural elements. By default the factor is 1.

examples.description: Scale the stiffness added to the nodes

notes: The 6.0 manual documents this command too, but the 6.00 binaries have no coupling commands at all (live top-level command enumeration on the PFC3D 6.00 GUI).
3D only live: the 2D binaries have no wall-structure command (7.00 and 9.8).

The manuals also document a 'wall-structure compute-stiffness' command; the engine's wall-structure enumeration (create, full-computation, stiffness-factor, update-tolerance) does not include it and it is rejected live on 7.00 and 9.8.
verification: Live-verified 2026-11-09 on PFC2D and PFC3D 7.00 and 9.8 consoles (plus the PFC3D 6.00 GUI for the 6.0 verdict) (syntax grade): accepted on PFC3D 7.00 and 9.8.
